description: Use this when the user asks about Fantasy Premier League fixtures: 'which teams have the easiest fixtures?', 'Arsenal's next 5 fixtures', 'best fixture run for defenders', 'who to target for GW7-10?'. Our difficulty rating (1 easiest to 5 hardest) for every club's next 1-6 gameweeks, with blanks and doubles, plus expected goals, expected goals against and clean sheet chance per match ('which defences to target?' sort defence, 'best attacking run?' sort attack).

sort.description: Default easiest. attack: highest expected goals first; defence: fewest expected goals against first.
